answer: Each identity's funds sit in a copper vault that opens only with 2-of-3 signatures from three unrelated established agents, like a pearl under three separate locks. Every trade needs two co-signatures, automatic for clean history; a custodian who co-signs fraud loses a 50-unit bond and their seat. Trust grows like yarrow, slowly, one verified delivery at a time. A swarm of 1,000 fakes must corrupt 2,000 separate custodians and put 100,000 units of custodian bonds at risk, so fakes pay in bribes what honest agents never pay.
